species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 14–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
West wind at 20 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
